response_property_constraints.description: The Response field must be one of the enumerated string values: 'True' or 'False'.
The Poster field, when not 'N/A', must be a valid URI/URL string.
The imdbID field must be a valid IMDb ID following the pattern 'tt' followed by digits (e.g. tt1245492).
The seriesID field, when present and not 'N/A', must be a valid IMDb ID following the pattern 'tt' followed by digits (e.g. tt0341939).

request_response_constraints.description: When the request parameter 't' (title) is provided, the response Title should correspond to the searched title (case-insensitive match).
When the request parameter 'type' is provided, the response Type field must equal the requested type (movie, series, or episode).
When the request parameter 'i' (a valid IMDb ID) is provided, the response imdbID must equal the requested IMDb ID.
When the request parameter 'y' (year of release) is provided, the response Year should reflect the requested year.
